purpose: Vetted sources for the AhhPuck tuning knowledge base. Every rule card must cite a source id from this file.

fields.layer: 1 physics, 2 engine-management systems, 3 OEM calibration method, 4 aftermarket tuning method, 5 hardware facts, 6 test standards, 7 this ECU and engine
fields.authority: textbook | course | standard | peer_reviewed | vendor | training | community
fields.use: summarise_and_cite (free/open) | cite_only (paid or copyrighted: rules and citations, never copied) | ask_permission (someone's own unofficial work)
fields.status: opened = page read on the accessed date | to_acquire = book or manual not yet held

sources.title: 2.61 Internal Combustion Engines (Spring 2017)
sources.notes: Graduate course; requires Heywood as the text.

sources.title: Advanced Powertrain Calibration and Optimisation short course

sources.title: Practical Standalone Tuning: the HPA 10-step process
sources.notes: Intro page names: I/O testing, trigger setup, base tables, base timing and fuel pressure, start-up, idle, steady-state fuel and ignition, full power, road/track validation.

sources.title: Inside EFI University
sources.notes: Founded 2003 by Ben Strader; dyno-based certification; emphasises math, physics and test data.

sources.title: Engine Management: Advanced Tuning
Lambda Sensor LSU 4.9 datasheet
sources.notes: Range λ 0.65–air; accuracy ±0.01 at λ0.8, ±0.007 at λ1.0, ±0.05 at λ1.7; needs LSU-IC controller; exhaust ≤2.5 bar.

sources.title: Webinar 407: Injector Characterisation & Dead Time
sources.notes: Dead time ~1 ms; rises with fuel pressure, falls with voltage; non-linear below ~1.5 ms.

sources.title: Engine Protection
sources.notes: Three severity levels; enrichment, lambda target, retard, rev limit; DTC-based reset.

sources.title: SAE J1349 Engine Power Test Code (2011; revised 2025)
